title: Executive Order 14404: Imposing Sanctions on Those Responsible for Repression in Cuba and for Threats to United States…
summary: Executive Order 14404, "Imposing Sanctions on Those Responsible for Repression in Cuba and for Threats to United States National Security and Foreign Policy", was signed on 2026-05-01 and published in the Federal Register on 2026-05-07 (91 FR 25061).
